title: Generate All Month–Category Combinations
description:
Use a CROSS JOIN to produce every possible combination of month and product category — useful as a scaffold for reports that must show all combinations even when data is missing.

**Table: months** — `month_num`, `month_name`
**Table: categories** — `id`, `name`

Return `month_name` and category `name` aliased as `category`. Order by `month_num`, then `category`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE months (month_num INT, month_name VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE categories (id INT, name VARCHAR); INSERT INTO months VALUES (1,'January'),(2,'February'),(3,'March'); INSERT INTO categories VALUES (1,'Electronics'),(2,'Clothing'),(3,'Food');
solution_sql: SELECT m.month_name, c.name AS category FROM months m CROSS JOIN categories c ORDER BY m.month_num, c.name
hints: A CROSS JOIN has no ON condition — it pairs every row from the left table with every row from the right.
The result count is always left_rows × right_rows.
explanation: CROSS JOIN produces a Cartesian product: each of the 3 months paired with each of the 3 categories gives 9 rows. This technique is used to pre-populate a reporting grid so that months or categories with zero sales still appear in the output.
